title: A Trip to the City
description: Hoa and her family spend a day in the city.
instructions: Read about Hoa's day in the city. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🚆 Last Sunday, Hoa and her family went to the city by train. Hoa's grandmother lives there, and they visit her every summer. The journey took two hours, and Hoa read a comic book on the train.
When they arrived, Grandma was waiting at the station. She was holding a big yellow umbrella because the sky was grey. 'It might rain this afternoon,' she said, 'so we should take our coats.'

First, they walked to the big park, where they saw a street artist. He was painting a picture of a dragon while people were watching him. Hoa's brother, Minh, gave him a coin, and the artist drew a small dragon for Minh.
At noon, they had lunch in a small restaurant opposite the park. Hoa ordered chicken and rice, and Minh ordered a big bowl of noodles. Grandma had vegetable soup because she does not eat meat.

🔬 In the afternoon, it started to rain, so they went to the science museum. It was warm and dry inside. Hoa pressed a button and made a model volcano erupt. Minh liked the space room best, because he could see a real rocket.
Before they went home, they bought presents in a shop near the station. Hoa bought a postcard for her best friend, Lucy, and Minh bought a keyring in the shape of a bus.
At seven o'clock, they said goodbye to Grandma. Hoa was tired but happy. On the train, she and Minh fell asleep very quickly. Next summer, they are going to stay with Grandma for a whole week.
